judgment.rationale: The follow-up suggests Explorer restart changes the behavior in at least one case. Compare Explorer-mediated launch with tray launch before treating it as the same failure as #49011.
evidence: The initial report identifies Windows 10 and PowerToysUserSetup 0.101.2432.0 x64.
A second report identifies a launch crash on 0.101.2712.0 on Windows 10 21H2. A later commenter says restarting Explorer recovered launch in their case.
judgment.recommended_action: Compare launch methods and capture the outcome before and after restarting Explorer in a disposable Windows 10 profile.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Settings does not open by double-clicking its icon on Windows 10; a later commenter reports recovery after restarting Explorer.
known_information: The original reporter could open Settings on a separate Windows 11 machine.
Open #49011 also tracks Windows 10 Settings launch failure; the issues are not confirmed to share a cause.
inferences: An Explorer or shell activation problem could explain the recovery in one report. It does not account for the crash in every reported configuration.
issue_context.analysis: Separate failure to start the Settings process from a process that starts and exits. Compare tray versus Explorer launch before restarting Explorer, then repeat both methods afterward.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the cross-machine reports and latest Explorer workaround. Verified that #49011 remains open; no runtime reproduction was performed.

fix_assessment.rationale: No separate PowerToys fix applies on present evidence. First distinguish the Explorer recovery case from the startup crash tracked in #49011.

actions.label: Compare Settings launch before and after restarting Explorer

reproduce.version_requirement: Reported 0.101 builds and current stable if compatible
prerequisites: Disposable Windows 10 test profile; record the Windows build and PowerToys install scope.
steps: Start PowerToys and try launching Settings from the tray, then through the same Explorer entry point used to reproduce the failure.
For each attempt, record whether the Settings process appears and exits or never starts.
Restart Explorer in the test profile and repeat both launch methods; compare with the conditions reported in #49011.
reproduce.expected_result: Both launch methods open Settings regardless of Explorer restart. A launch-method-only failure and a process crash should be recorded separately.
